purpose: Machine-readable profile of COPOPS, a singular (member) cooperative within the CEPOTX central system. COPOPS is the sub-cooperative for the Uruará/Transamazônica area; Raimundo & Geniza's Sítio (RG-P1) is a member site.
excluded_for_privacy: FDA registration PINs and any personal CPF are intentionally omitted from this public repo.

notes: COPOPS is one of CEPOTX's four singular cooperatives (with COOPOXIN, COPOTRAN, COPCAO — per Coopere Mais 2026-07). Presidente Raimundo Silva matches our farmer Raimundo (Uruará plot RG-P1). Site code U-06-07 captured from Raimundo's site app screenshot (governor-provided); pending confirmation at first purchase.
